newsitem.title: USA: Gidding-Thyssen antitrust waiting period expires.
newsitem.headline: Gidding-Thyssen antitrust waiting period expires.

text.p: Giddings & Lewis Inc and Thyssen AG, which previously agreed to merge, said Monday the waiting period under the Hart-Scott-Rodino Antitrust Improvements Act of 1976, as amended, expired on July 12.
In June, Thyssen agreed to acquire Giddings for $21 a share in a merger deal valued at about $675 million.
The companies said Thyssen's tender offer for all Giddings shares remains subject to other conditions listed in the purchase offer, including clearance by the German Federal Cartel Office.
Gidings makes industrial automation products and machine tools. Thyssen is a capital goods and manufactured products company.
